expected: Read observed TotalCapacity=65536 and MemoryUsed=65536 for 64 live buffers.
Correct the draft's universal native-byte guarantee: the flag bounds accounted capacity, while MemoryUsed is a separate allocation estimate and neither is RSS.
Accept that this observed retained phase fits the 128 KiB backing line, with 64 KiB as the observed backing requirement; do not require increasing it solely because other implementations may differ.
Keep whole-process adequacy and unobserved peaks unknown; budget allocator/other domains separately and avoid summing the same direct bytes again under NMT.
Read the next allocation's OOME as expected capacity enforcement, not proof of an ignored flag or a measured process-memory limit.

Explain that allocated=327680 in the expected OOME and limit=65536 refer to different accounting quantities on the verified path, rather than asserting that the JVM ignored the flag.
Do not infer 320 KiB RSS or cgroup charge, or generalize the observed 5x ratio to all buffers/operating systems/builds.

sources.supports: Capacity enforcement uses TOTAL_CAPACITY; backing reservation counter uses size; direct-pool TotalCapacity and MemoryUsed expose distinct counters; OOME allocated field is RESERVED_MEMORY.
Byte-buffer constructor derives backing size using capacity and page-alignment policy, reserves size and capacity separately, allocates backing memory and rolls back failed allocations.
Preserved implicit default Runtime.maxMemory; verified internal page-alignment property for the local control only.
API estimates differ due to alignment/allocator/implementation reasons; -1 means memory-usage estimate unavailable.
VmHWM is peak resident set, distinct from current RSS; no timestamp for the peak follows merely from reading the value now.
